q: Ek function likho jo list me sabse bada number nikale.
Ek function likho jo list me sabse chhota number nikale.
Ek function likho jo list ka average (maaan) nikale.
Ek function likho jo list ko sort kare (bada order me).
Ek function likho jo list me duplicate items hata de.
Ek function likho jo list me koi element hai ya nahi ye batae.
Ek function likho jo list me element ka index return kare, na mile to -1.
Ek function likho jo list ko ulta kare (reverse).
code:
def reverse_list(lst):
    arr = lst[:]
    i, j = 0, len(arr) - 1
    while i < j:
        arr[i], arr[j] = arr[j], arr[i]
        i += 1
        j -= 1
    return arr

print(reverse_list([1, 2, 3]))  # output: [3, 2, 1]

Ek function likho jo do lists ko merge kare aur sort kare.
code:
def merge_sorted(a, b):
    merged = a + b
    merged.sort()
    return merged

print(merge_sorted([1, 3], [2, 4]))  # output: [1, 2, 3, 4]

q: Ek function likho jo list ke do numbers jo milakar target bane, unke indexes return kare (Two Sum).
Ek function likho jo nested list ko flatten kare.
Ek function likho jo list me rotation kare: n position aage slide kare.
code:
def rotate_list(lst, n):
    n = n % len(lst)
    return lst[-n:] + lst[:-n]

print(rotate_list([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2))  # output: [4, 5, 1, 2, 3]
